svg.aria-label: game-dev: Idea to playable game, motivation first. Design, Roblox, VFX, models, and MCP for every engine. Steps: Motivation, who plays and which drive; Brief, one page, the loop first; Engine, web, or Roblox Studio; Build, the core loop, run and looked at; Playtest, through Studio's MCP server; Grow, one feature a sitting. Output: a game you can play, and the next feature named.
